text: {"overall_winner":"A","qualities":[{"evidence":"clear position with \"Although there are some setbacks... there are many more advantages\"","quality":"argumentative stance","description":"It states a definite position and consistently defends that side throughout the essay."},{"evidence":"mentions liability, cost, fuel savings, stress, and in-car entertainment","quality":"supporting evidence","description":"It uses several relevant details from the source to back up its claims instead of relying only on opinions."},{"evidence":"\"If the technology fails... who is at fault-the driver or the manufacturer?\" and \"initial cost to change the way the world uses transportation\"","quality":"issue analysis","description":"It explains specific concerns and consequences rather than just naming pros and cons."},{"evidence":"\"All in all...\" and repeated restatement of the main claim in the final paragraph","quality":"conclusion development","description":"It ends with a fuller wrap-up that restates the argument and closes the essay more effectively."},{"evidence":"multiple body paragraphs with topic sentences like \"However\" and \"On the contrast\"","quality":"organization","description":"It has a clearer introduction, body, and conclusion structure with more developed transitions between ideas."}]}
